# Colour-frame sources

These journals are immutable, byte-for-byte captures of completed or halted real
Tickmarkr runs. They live with the colour corpus so regenerating a frame never
depends on a live or mutating run directory.

- `run-20260718-000943.journal.jsonl` was copied on 2026-07-25 from the
  completed `.tickmarkr/runs/run-20260718-000943/journal.jsonl` capture. Its
  SHA-256 is `48302a97d65c012781eda747f4d82b8b9f71649f5c4daaef3da37b25105c45e2`.
- `run-20260725-025004.interrupted.journal.jsonl` is the existing halted-run
  capture used by the cockpit demo. Its SHA-256 is
  `96615dc94cbdb5d2b375c0d286c5a476be5037a259eacb443e163cb3c7af5d5b`.

Never edit either journal. Replace it only with another verbatim capture and
record that capture's provenance and digest here.
